messages:
Maya: Heads up — PR <https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/19872|#19872> adds a fallback routing policy to route to `quantized-compat` variants when full models are unavailable. Need quick eyes from runtime + platform + infra + security before we can run a canary. @Sam @Li @Jordan can you take this?
Sam: I can take platform. please add a short canary plan (rollout %, timing) and the metrics we should watch (latency/error/fallback-rate). :eyes:
Maya: Thanks — draft canary plan below. TL;DR: 10% for 2h -> 50% for 6h -> 100%. Watch p95 token latency, fallback_rate, and error_rate. Canary config added to PR:```yaml
rollout:
  - pct: 10
    duration: 2h
  - pct: 50
    duration: 6h
  - pct: 100
    duration: 0m
metrics:
  - p95_token_latency
  - fallback_rate
  - error_rate
```Rollback: if fallback_rate > 5% or error_rate spike > 3x baseline.
Li: Infra note: `quantized-compat` infra is on a different GPU SKU (A100q). We need eviction guard and a memory limit check plus a small autoscale tweak. I'll add infra comments on the PR — probably need a pod annotation to avoid eviction during the canary.
Jordan: Sec check: does this PR introduce any new KMS calls or new user-identifiable logging? If not, I can do a quick review. CCing @security-ops for audit expectations.
deploy-bot: CI passed: unit tests 142/142 ✅, integration flaky: 2 failures in tests/kv_cache_test (re-ran).
Sam: Left a couple comments about route weighting when the KV cache warms up — request a small e2e simulation that toggles capacity and asserts no traffic blackholing.
Maya: Added an e2e sim job linked in the PR and a canary rollback hook: if fallback_rate > 5% for 10m -> immediate rollback. Link: <https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/job/3981>.
Li: Ack, I'll review the infra diffs tomorrow morning and flag autoscale/annotation changes if needed.
Jordan: Will run a security pass in ~2 hrs. No KMS changes seen in initial diff. If audit events change, will raise it here.
Sam: :thumbsup: If infra + sec are green by EOD, can we schedule canary for 10:30 PT tomorrow? Need oncall-runtime to hold the window.
oncall-runtime: Holding 10:30-11:30 PT for the canary slot. I'll monitor logs and be ready to rollback.
Maya: Great — tagging @oncall-runtime ✅. If anyone hits blocking concerns, please comment on the PR directly rather than in-thread. I'll start the merge/rollout checklist once we have infra+sec thumbs. —Maya
